script: Registration, tax and consumer laws depend on your country. This video gives general guidance. Confirm the rules with your local tax office or an accountant before you take customer money. Open a separate bank account. Keep every receipt. Move a fixed percentage of each profit into a tax savings account. You need a store platform, a product research tool, a supplier platform, an ad account, a spreadsheet and an email tool. Check current prices on official websites before you buy. Write the end date of every free trial in your calendar on the day you start. Cancel any tool you have not used in two weeks.
glossary: dropshipping, supplier, ROAS, CPA, stop-loss, Shopify
